title: Honey Spice Cake
description: A medieval-leaning honey cake made for a D&D session. Works in the Thermomix or the Ambiano mixer.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a cake tin.
Cream the butter ({{butter}}) and brown sugar ({{sugar}}) until pale and light.
Beat in the eggs ({{eggs}}) one at a time, then the honey ({{honey}}), milk ({{milk}}) and orange zest ({{orange}} orange).
Fold through the flour ({{flour}}), ginger ({{ginger}}), cinnamon ({{cinnamon}}), the other spices and the baking powder until just combined.
Bake 40–45 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean. If the centre is still liquid, tent with foil and give it more time rather than more heat.
Cool in the tin before turning out.

notes.title: Amounts still open
notes.text: Flour, honey, butter, sugar, eggs, milk, ginger and cinnamon are confirmed from the original session. The clove, nutmeg and baking powder amounts were not captured. Ask me to rebuild this card before you bake it again.

notes.title: Whole cloves instead of ground
notes.text: Grind them with the brown sugar, 20–30 sec / Speed 9. Repeat if any pieces survive.

notes.title: Fresh ginger instead of ground
notes.text: About 1 tbsp grated fresh per ¼ tsp ground, so 2–3 tbsp here. Grate very fine, or grind with the sugar.

notes.title: If you forget the honey
notes.text: Warm it with a splash of water or orange juice until pourable, skewer holes across the warm cake, and spoon it over.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: Airtight at room temperature 3–4 days. Often better on day two.
